form.label: AD – Group & GPO Changes
form.description: Active Directory group membership and Group Policy Object changes — privilege escalation & configuration drift visibility

input.label: 🔍 Global Search Filter
input.placeholder: Filter by user, group, GPO, or administrator

div.style: background: #fce4ec; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 4px; border-left: 4px solid #C62828; margin-bottom: 8px;
div.p: Monitors creation, modification, and deletion of Group Policy Objects (GPOs) — critical for security configuration management.

search.query:
`DC-index` (sourcetype="WinEventLog:Security" OR source="WinEventLog:Security") EventCode IN (5136, 5137, 5138, 5139, 5141) | search $search_filter$ | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*Security ID:\s*(?<Subject_SID>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*Account Name:\s*(?<Subject_Account_Name>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*Account Domain:\s*(?<Subject_Account_Domain>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*Logon ID:\s*(?<Logon_ID>[^\r\n]+)"
| rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*DN:\s*(?<ObjectDN>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*GUID:\s*(?<ObjectGUID>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*Class:\s*(?<ObjectClass>[^\r\n]+)"
| rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*LDAP Display Name:\s*(?<AttrName>[^\r\n]+)" | rex field=Message "(?im)^\s*Value:\s*(?<AttrValue>[^\r\n]+)"
| rex field=Message "(?is)Operation:.*?Type:\s*(?<OperationType>[^\r\n]+)"
| eval AdminUser = Subject_Account_Name | eval AdminDomain = Subject_Account_Domain | eval admin_logonID = Logon_ID | eval ObjectClass = trim(ObjectClass) | eval AttrName = trim(AttrName) | eval AttrValue = trim(AttrValue) | eval OperationType = trim(OperationType)
| where ObjectClass = "groupPolicyContainer" OR ObjectClass = "organizationalUnit" OR ObjectClass = "container" OR AttrName IN ("gPLink","gPOptions","displayName","versionNumber", "flags","gPCFileSysPath","gPCFunctionalityVersion") OR match(ObjectDN, "(?i)CN=Policies,CN=System") OR match(ObjectDN, "(?i)CN=\{[A-F0-9\-]+\},CN=Policies")
| eval Action = case( EventCode=5137 AND ObjectClass="groupPolicyContainer", "GPO Created", EventCode=5141 AND ObjectClass="groupPolicyContainer", "GPO Deleted", EventCode=5136 AND AttrName="gPLink" AND OperationType="Value Added", "GPO Linked to OU", EventCode=5136 AND AttrName="gPLink" AND OperationType="Value Deleted", "GPO Unlinked from OU", EventCode=5136 AND AttrName="gPOptions", "Block Inheritance Changed", EventCode=5136 AND AttrName="versionNumber", "GPO Version Updated", EventCode=5136 AND AttrName="displayName", "GPO Renamed", EventCode=5139, "Object Moved", EventCode=5137, "Object Created", EventCode=5141, "Object Deleted", EventCode=5136, "Object Modified", 1=1, "Other" )
| rex field=AttrValue "(?i)cn=\{(?<GPO_GUID>[A-F0-9\-]+)\}" | rex field=AttrValue "(?i);(?<GPO_Option>\d)\]" | eval GPO_Option = case( GPO_Option="0", "Enabled", GPO_Option="1", "Disabled", GPO_Option="2", "Enforced", GPO_Option="3", "Disabled+Enforced", 1=1, GPO_Option) | rex field=ObjectDN "(?i)CN=\{(?<DN_GPO_GUID>[A-F0-9\-]+)\}" | rex field=ObjectDN "(?i)CN=(?<DN_GPO_Name>[^,]+),CN=Policies"
| rex field=Message "Old DN:\s+(?<old_dn>.*)" | rex field=Message "New DN:\s+(?<new_dn>.*)"
| eval GPO_GUID = coalesce(GPO_GUID, DN_GPO_GUID, ObjectGUID) | eval GPO_Name = coalesce(DN_GPO_Name, GPO_GUID, "Unknown GPO")
| rex field=ObjectDN "(?i)(?<TargetOU>OU=[^,]+(?:,OU=[^,]+)*)"
| eval TargetObject = case( EventCode=5139, "Old: " . old_dn . " | New: " . new_dn, 1=1, ObjectDN)
| eval Changes = case( Action="GPO Linked to OU", "GPO '" . GPO_Name . "' (" . GPO_GUID . ") linked to " . TargetOU . " [" . GPO_Option . "]", Action="GPO Unlinked from OU", "GPO '" . GPO_Name . "' (" . GPO_GUID . ") unlinked from " . TargetOU, Action="Block Inheritance Changed", "gPOptions set to " . AttrValue . " on " . TargetOU, Action="GPO Version Updated", "versionNumber changed to " . AttrValue . " for " . GPO_Name, Action="GPO Renamed", "displayName changed to " . AttrValue . " for " . GPO_GUID, Action="GPO Created", "New GPO created: " . ObjectDN, Action="GPO Deleted", "GPO deleted: " . ObjectDN, isnotnull(AttrName), "Attribute '" . AttrName . "' = " . AttrValue, 1=1, Action)
| table _time, ComputerName, AdminUser, AdminDomain, admin_logonID, TargetObject, GPO_GUID, Action, ObjectClass, Changes
| rename ComputerName as Computer, AdminUser as "Admin User", AdminDomain as "Admin Domain", admin_logonID as "Logon ID", TargetObject as "Target Object DN", GPO_Name as "GPO Name", GPO_GUID as "GPO GUID", GPO_Option as "Link Option", ObjectClass as "Object Class", Changes as "Details"
| sort - _time

format.colorPalette: {"GPO Created":#2E7D32, "Object Created":#43A047, "GPO Deleted":#B71C1C, "Object Deleted":#E53935, "GPO Linked to OU":#1565C0, "GPO Unlinked from OU":#FB8C00, "Block Inheritance Changed":#F9A825, "GPO Version Updated":#00838F, "GPO Renamed":#6A1B9A, "Object Moved":#5E35B1, "Object Modified":#EF6C00, "Other":#9E9E9E}
